# 73-103 · Principles of Macroeconomics

::: {.hero-instructor}
**Professor:** Andrés Castaño Zuluaga
:::


::: {.hero-sub}
Macroeconomics seeks to understand why some countries are rich and others poor; why some countries have high rates of inflation while others maintain stable prices; why countries experience phases of (sometimes rapid) expansion and subsequent (sometimes sharp) contraction; and how fiscal and monetary policy can reduce the frequency and severity of these episodes. Full policies and grading: [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd).
:::

::: {.hero-meta}
[Mon & Wed · 10:00–11:15 · CMB 1199]{.hero-chip}
:::
:::

  function ymd(d) {
    return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");
  }
  function pickPhase(today) {
    var t = ymd(today);
    for (var i = 0; i < phases.length; i++) if (t < phases[i].until) return phases[i];
    return phases[phases.length - 1];
  }
  var root = document.getElementById("where-we-are");
  if (!root) return;
  var phase = pickPhase(new Date());
  var titleEl = document.getElementById("cf-title");
  var bodyEl = document.getElementById("cf-body");
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = phase.title;
  if (bodyEl) bodyEl.innerHTML = "<p>" + phase.html + "</p>";
  root.setAttribute("data-phase", phase.id);
})();
</script>

## Models you will actually use

We move from measurement to goods, financial markets, and IS–LM, then a thin labor / Phillips discussion, we transition into productivity and  economic growth, and finish with the open economy.
